title: Integrate a signed density query before seeking a positive normalized output
statement: For finite detector cells proposeiwith(Ai+D Bi)/(1+D Zbeta), sampleVfromM^betaconditional on that cell, queryHt(V), then accept with(Ai+Bi Ht(V))/(Ai+D Bi). The acquiredAi>D Bi margins make every realization a valid probability and its average numerator is the true cell mass. Expected proposals are1+D Zbeta<1.001. Fine/tail cells can fail the margin, so this is not automatic continuous-density sampling.
